blurb: Rose Bowl Riders is a volunteer-run, not-for-profit equestrian center on 12 oak-shaded acres in Pasadena’s Hahamongna Watershed Park. The facility includes arenas, boarding, and access to miles of trails in the Arroyo Seco and Angeles National Forest. They offer riding lessons for members and community events such as horse shows and camps.
extraNote: Guests must complete a waiver before visiting or riding · Membership dues do not include lesson fees · Rose Bowl Riders facility at Lower Hahamongna Watershed Park, 4750 Oak Grove Drive, Pasadena, CA
